records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Quartz Systems* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero reply to the onboarding email [email:740c78a9]. No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Starter plan, single admin, 8 days left; accounts silent through the first week rarely self-start.

draft.subject: A simple first step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Checking in since your Wrenfield account went live last week. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project with a few tasks is usually the easiest place to begin. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
